mapper.sql: COALESCE (s.last_data_day = #{day}, 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average t WHERE t.item_id=s.item_id AND t.platform=s.platform AND t.source=s.source AND t.trade_day= #{day} AND ( t . min_price IS NULL OR t . max_price IS NULL ) )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wf_market_statistics_sync (item_id, platform, source, collection_day, daily_attempts) VALUES
(#{id}, #{platform}, #{source}, #{day}, 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_attempts=IF(collection_day IS NULL OR collection_day < VALUES(collection_day), 0, daily_attempts), collection_day=GREATEST(COALESCE(collection_day, VALUES(collection_day)), VALUES(collection_day))
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_market_statistics_sync s SET published_day=#{day}, published_success=() WHERE s.platform=#{platform} AND s.source=#{source} AND s.collection_day=#{day} AND (s.published_day IS NULL OR s.published_day <= #{day})
mapper.select: SELECT s.published_day AS trade_day, COUNT(*) AS total_items, SUM(s.published_success) AS processed_items FROM wf_market_statistics_sync s WHERE s.platform = #{platform} AND s.source = #{source} AND s.published_day < UTC_DATE() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_market_daily_trade_average t WHERE t.platform = s.platform AND t.source = s.source AND t.trade_day = s.published_day AND t.average_price > 0 AND t.volume > 0) GROUP BY s.published_day HAVING SUM(s.published_success) * 100 >= COUNT(*) * 99 ORDER BY s.published_day DESC LIMIT 1
